questions.solution:
Let the 1st number be Q,  2nd number = Q(1 - 20%) = 0.8Q,  3rd number = 0.8Q(1 + 200%) = 2.4Q

The difference between the  3rd number and the original number = 2.4Q - Q = 1.4Q

The difference between the 2nd and 3rd number = 2.4Q - 0.8Q = 1.6Q

Now, % less = \(\frac {1.6Q - 1.4Q}{1.6Q} \times 100\%\) = 12.5%

questions.question: A boat covers a certain distance against the stream in 9 hours 36 min and it covers the same distance along the stream in 6 hours. What is the ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream?

questions.solution:
We know, 9 hours 36 min = 576 min and 6 hour = 360 min

Through upstream (U) and downstream(D) distance is constant, then time ∝ 1/speed

Time ratio of U : D = 576 : 360 = 8 : 5, then Speed ratio of U : D = 5 : 8

Speed of boat = (D speed + U speed)/2 = (8 + 5)/2 = 13/2 and speed of stream =  (D speed - U speed)/2 = (8 - 5)/2 = 3/2

So, Speed of boat : Speed of stream = 13/2 : 3/2 = 13 : 3

questions.question: Raju, Shobh and Mohan can do a work in 15 days, 20 days and 25 days respectively. In how many days,will the work be finished, if they do it on alternate days, Starting from Raju?
questions.questionHtml: Raju, Shobh and Mohan can do a work in 15 days, 20 days and 25 days respectively. In how many days,will the work be finished, if they do it on alternate days, Starting from Raju?
questions.solution:
Total work = LCM of (15, 20, 25) = 300 unit

Efficiency of A (Raju) = 300/15 = 20 units/day, efficiency of B (Shobh)  = 300/20 = 15 units/day and efficiency of C (Mohan)  = 300/25 = 12 units/day

In three days, working on alternate days, they complete = (20 + 15 + 12) = 47 units of work, so in 18 days they do (47 × 6) = 282 unit

Remaining work = 300 - 282 = 18 units, done by A in \(\frac {18}{20} = \frac {9}{10}\ days\)

Total time taken = 6 × 3 + \(\frac {9}{10}\) = \(18\frac{9}{{10}}\) days

The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'Banners were being prepared by them with different designs for the sports meet.'

Key Points

  • The given sentence is in the active voice. We have to change the sentence into passive form. 
  • The given sentence is written in 'past continuous tense.'
  • The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
    • Active Voice: Subject + was/were + (verb+ing) + Object.
    • Passive Voice:  Object + was/were + being + V3 + by (preposition) + Subject.
  • Let’s see another example:
    • Active voice: They were organising the party.
    • Passive voice: The party was being organised by them.
  • The subject of the given sentence is 'They' and the object of the given sentence is 'banners'. 
  • The subject 'They' will be changed into 'them'.
  • So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged and 'by' will be added. 
  • Also here, 'were preparing' will be changed into 'were being prepared'.
  • The remaining portion will not be changed. 

 

Correct Sentence: Banners were being prepared by them with different designs for the sports meet.
